title: Shipping cost tiers
prompt: Implement `int shippingCost(int items, boolean prime)`: free (0) when prime AND at least 1 item; 5 when NOT prime and items >= 10; 8 when NOT prime and items >= 3; 12 otherwise. Order your checks so the tiers fall out naturally.

tests.name: prime shoppers
tests.hint: Prime always ships free (with at least one item).
